sections.description:
Boost Your WooCommerce Sales with Nimbbl: The 1-Click Checkout for India

Transform your WooCommerce store’s payment experience with Nimbbl. We bring the power of 1-Click Checkout to your website, helping you close sales faster and reduce cart abandonment.

By integrating the Nimbbl plugin, you aren’t just adding a payment gateway; you are upgrading to an intelligent checkout engine that offers Magik UPI, Smart Address Auto-Fill, COD support, and multiple payment aggregators in a single, robust solution.

Why Leading D2C Brands Choose Nimbbl:

🚀 Checkout in Under 5 Seconds
Eliminate friction. Our 1-Click Checkout removes the need for OTPs, complex forms, and redirections for returning users. Give your customers the fastest path from “Add to Cart” to “Payment Successful.”

⚡ Smart Address Auto-Fill
Stop losing customers to long forms. Nimbbl automatically fetches and pre-fills your customer’s delivery address based on their mobile number. This saves time, reduces typing errors, and helps convert visitors into buyers instantly.

✨ Magical UPI payments
Experience the future of UPI payments. Our proprietary Magik UPI flow allows customers to pay directly without switching apps or remembering VPA handles.
* Benefit: Reduces UPI drop-offs by 25% and lowers your transaction processing costs.

📦 Seamless Cash on Delivery (COD)
Cater to every customer preference. Nimbbl fully supports Cash on Delivery (COD), allowing you to offer a complete range of payment options. Manage both prepaid and COD orders from a single unified dashboard.

💳 Fast Buy Now Pay Later
Unlock higher average order values (AOV) by offering seamless credit. Nimbbl automatically detects and displays eligible “Pay Later” options for your customers upfront, with no extra clicks required.

🔗 The Power of Multiple Aggregators
Stop relying on a single payment gateway. Nimbbl unifies India’s top payment aggregators into one integration.
* Resilience: If one gateway goes down, switch to another instantly from your dashboard.
* Control: Route transactions based on success rates or costs without touching your code.

Features at a Glance

  • Smart Address Pre-fill: Auto-fetches addresses for faster checkouts.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD): Built-in support for COD orders.
  • Unified Payments Interface (UPI): Supports Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and our exclusive Magik UPI flow.
  • Credit & Debit Cards: Accept Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, and American Express with support for international cards.
  • Netbanking & Wallets: Coverage for 72+ banks and 15+ popular mobile wallets.
  • Cardless EMI: Make premium products affordable with cardless EMI options.
  • Transparent Checkout: Display tax, shipping, and fees clearly on the payment page to build trust.

Merchant-Friendly Pricing
* Zero Setup Fee: Free to install and setup.
* Transparent Pricing: Pay only per successful transaction. View Checkout Charges

Available only for Indian registered businesses.

Other details

  • Privacy Policy: https://nimbbl.biz/privacy-policy/
  • Website: https://nimbbl.biz/
  • FAQs: https://nimbbl.biz/frequently-asked-questions

Need Help?
If you face any integration issues, please reach out to us at help@nimbbl.biz.

Contributors

Nimbbl WooCommerce is open-source software.
* https://profiles.wordpress.org/nimbblplugin/

Fixation

  1. Minor fixes
sections.installation:
GETTING STARTED

Before installing the plugin, you will need your Access Key and Secret Key. These credentials authenticate your store with Nimbbl servers.

  1. Existing Users: Login to the Nimbbl Dashboard to retrieve your keys.
  2. New Users: If you don’t have an account yet, please Sign Up Here.
    • Note: Account approval and login details typically take up to 1 working day to be issued.

Step 1: Install Plugin

You can install the plugin automatically via the WordPress directory or manually by uploading the files.

Option 1: Automatic Installation (Recommended)
1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
3. Search for “Nimbbl”.
4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Option 2: Manual Installation
1. Download the latest plugin .zip file from the WordPress repository.
2. In your WordPress Admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
3. Select the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
4. Click Activate Plugin.

Step 2: Configuration

Once activated, follow these steps to connect your store:

  1. Navigate to Settings: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  2. Select Nimbbl: Find “Nimbbl” in the list and click Manage (or click the “Finish set up” button).
  3. Enable Payment Method: Check the box to enable Nimbbl.
  4. Add Description: We recommend using the following text for better conversion:
    > Pay securely with your preferred mode: UPI, Cards, Netbanking, or Buy Now Pay Later.
  5. Enter Credentials:
    • Select “Test” mode for the Environment.
    • Enter your Test Access Key and Test Secret Key (copied from your Nimbbl Dashboard).
  6. Save Changes.

Step 3: Setting Up Webhooks

Webhooks ensure your order statuses (e.g., Pending, Paid, Failed) update automatically in WooCommerce when a payment is completed.

  1. In the Nimbbl Plugin settings, look for the Webhook URL field.
  2. The plugin automatically generates this URL for you.
  3. Action Required: Copy this URL and email it to help@nimbbl.biz or share it with your Nimbbl account manager to have it whitelisted on our servers.

Step 4: Go Live

  1. Test Your Store: Ensure “Test Mode” is enabled in the plugin settings and perform a few test transactions to verify the flow.
  2. Switch to Live:
    • Go to Nimbbl Plugin Settings.
    • Change the Environment from Test to Live.
    • Enter your Live Access Key and Live Secret Key.
    • Click Save Changes.
    • You are now ready to accept real payments!
